title: qa-ui-auto Test Case
description: Typed YAML test case consumed by .agents/skills/qa-ui-auto/scripts/runner.py. Authored by humans or by Claude Code via the qa-ui-auto skill. Inline JS is forbidden; only verbs from the controlled step library are allowed.

id.description: Unique stable identifier, e.g. TC-001 or TC-zmodem-conflict-overwrite.

covers.description: Feature IDs from tests/features.yaml that this case exercises.

modes.description: Modes this case is valid in. Default is [browser]. Use [native] only when the case truly needs the Tauri Rust backend (local PTY, native dialogs, system clipboard).

fixtures.description: Pre/post fixtures applied around this case. Each is implemented in scripts/fixtures/.

native_platforms.description: Optional native platform restriction. Does not certify that a platform was tested.

browser_platforms.description: Optional browser platform restriction for OS-dependent renderer chrome (e.g. macOS title-bar). Coverage stays global; the skip is explicit per host.

skip.description: If set, the case is skipped and this reason is recorded in the report.

selector.description: Playwright-syntax selector. Prefer 'data-testid=...'. Other accepted: 'role=...', 'text=...', CSS, XPath via 'xpath=...'.

step.description: Each step is a single-key map: {verb: args}. The args schema is verb-specific.

assert_file_contains.description: Native-only: host-side disk re-read proving the save pipeline wrote the content (G0 disk-effect evidence).

assert_file_receipt.description: Native-only: independently hashes host bytes and reconciles encoding, BOM, EOL, length, disk hash, logical hash, and history identity with a production save receipt observation.

equals.description: exact lowercase SHA-256 hex digest, or a ${fixture.*} placeholder that resolves to one before the step runs

assert_file_sha256.description: Native-only: independently hashes host file bytes and compares the digest with an exact expected SHA-256.

value.description: JSON text stored verbatim under key.

seed_storage.description: Controlled persistence fixture: write one localStorage entry so native cases can enter a workspace without the undrivable native folder picker.

reload_window.description: Reload the webview document so store bootstraps re-read storage; waits for welcome-panel.

vault_first_run.description: Complete the empty-vault first-run master-password gate with the given QA password. Locked vault => loud failure; unlocked => no-op.

parity008_hold.description: Browser parity008 fixture: hold git_blob_pair responses for this repo root (null clears).

parity008_release.description: Browser parity008 fixture: release held diff reads; fails when none is pending.

platform_choice.description: Native-only: on the listed platforms the dialog must appear and `click` answers it; elsewhere it must stay absent.

host_make_tree.description: Native-only: create a sample tree inside the case directory and record SHA-256 per entry in <root>-tree.json.

save_text.description: Native-only diagnostics: write an element's text to a file inside the report root.

from_position.description: Pixel offset within the 'from' element where the target-based drag starts (Playwright source_position).

to_position.description: Pixel offset within the 'to' element where the target-based drag ends (Playwright target_position).

by.description: Offset drag from the element's centre (CSS px); never scrolls a target into view mid-drag.

focus_prechecked.description: Skip the immediate WebDriver focus probe only when the testcase asserted DOM focus immediately before an external fault that makes WebDriver commands unavailable.

focus_target.description: Focus the selector through WebDriver immediately before verifying ownership and injecting keys. Mutually exclusive with focus_prechecked.

ready_selector.description: Optional visible selector polled after native input setup and immediately before key delivery.

ready_stable_sec.description: Require the ready element identity and markup to remain unchanged for this duration before delivering keys. Requires ready_selector.

require_keydown_prevented.description: Require each delivered keydown to be consumed with preventDefault; available only with WebDriver event observation.

transport.description: Native key transport. WebDriver uses packaged-webview W3C key actions; x11 uses XTest.

anyOf.description: typed one character at a time; same semantics as the single-char array form

capture_text.description: default true; false skips per-mutation textContent reads so multi-megabyte documents are not dominated by probe overhead

label.description: names the per-invocation artifact native-editor-performance-<label>.json so repeated measurement groups accumulate instead of overwriting

native_clipboard_owner_arg.description: Native-only: external X11 CLIPBOARD selection owner. grant takes the real selection; deny advertises standard text targets but rejects their conversion; suspend stops the owner so every client's read genuinely fails; resume restores the last granted text; release terminates it and records that the host selection was replaced.

assert_system_clipboard_arg.description: Native-only: out-of-process read of the real X11 CLIPBOARD selection. Exactly one of equals/contains/readable.

macos_key.description: Chord used instead of key on macOS, where the IDEA macOS keymap binds a different stroke (e.g. Meta+1 for Alt+1).

menu_items_arg.description: Each entry is the visible label of a context-menu item to assert visible.

eval_readonly_arg.description: READ-ONLY JavaScript expression evaluated in the page. May not contain assignments, function declarations, DOM mutations, or `await`. Validator rejects steps that look like side effects.

contains.description: Optional: assert that String(result) contains this substring.

timeout_sec.description: Poll the read-only condition until it passes or this timeout expires; zero evaluates once.

seed_dialog_arg.description: Pre-arm window.prompt and window.confirm responses for the next interaction.

mode.description: fault stage only: unknown-response withholds one real successful response immediately; unknown-response-delay holds the real response (success or typed failure) behind the fault hold so the runner can mutate the real disk before the production read-back classification runs

save_race_arm_arg.description: ED-PARITY-002 isolated-QA-build only: arm one save-transaction delivery point (prepare/ack/watcher) or a controlled unknown-response write fault. Fails explicitly when the binary is not the QA build with the save gate.

save_race_wait_entered_arg.description: ED-PARITY-002 isolated-QA-build only: block until the armed delivery point is entered (the production save transaction or the delayed fault is genuinely held there).

save_race_release_arg.description: ED-PARITY-002 isolated-QA-build only: release the held delivery point so the production transaction continues.

expect_contains.description: ordered subsequence of timeline events that must be present

require_settled_kind.description: assert the last recorded production commit-settled result kind

require_readback_outcome.description: assert the last recorded unknown-effect read-back classification

forbid_between.description: assert none of the listed events occurred between the anchor and the until event (e.g. zero writer invocations during a W0 hold)

save_race_trace_arg.description: ED-PARITY-002 isolated-QA-build only: persist the in-page save-race timeline artifact and assert recorded events; ack-delivered entries carry the real native writtenHash.

expression.description: read-only JS expression; mutation-looking expressions are rejected

save_race_note_arg.description: ED-PARITY-002 isolated-QA-build only: record one read-only DOM/JS observation (focus, selection, undo text, recovery row) into save-race-notes.json. Recording only; never executes app actions.

host_delete_file_arg.description: Native-only: delete an existing host file inside the retained report root and record its before hash. Used for the unreadable read-back branch of a controlled response fault.

open_route_arg.description: Navigate to an app route (browser: base_url+route; native: same-origin navigation of the main WebView).

host_helper_arg.description: Native-only: start/stop the stdlib-Tk visual target used by RDP latency/throughput cases.

rdp_probe_arg.description: Native-only: run one rdp-probe scenario and assert its JSON report.

host_clipboard_arg.description: Native-only: set/assert the real OS clipboard with platform tools (PowerShell/.NET, AppKit JXA, xclip).

seconds.description: quiet: how long to watch the OS clipboard for changes.

max_changes.description: quiet: most clipboard changes allowed while watching (default 0).

same_tree_as.description: files assert: the clipboard entry named like this report-root tree has identical relative paths and SHA-256.

mouse_path_arg.description: Move the pointer through element-relative points without clicking: dx/dy are CSS-pixel offsets from the element centre (W3C element origin), steps interpolates intermediate moves, pause_ms rests afterwards.

path.description: PNG fixture; relative paths resolve from the repository root.

browser_fake_camera_arg.description: Browser-only: replace navigator.mediaDevices with one fake camera. qr streams `image` from a canvas, none reports no camera, denied rejects getUserMedia with NotAllowedError. Not camera hardware or permission evidence.

image.description: PNG fixture; relative paths resolve from the repository root.

assert_totp_code_arg.description: Exactly one element's code attribute must equal an independent Python RFC 6238 code for the current (or just-rolled-over) time step.

native_show_image_window_arg.description: Native Linux/X11 and Windows: show (default) a topmost Tk window with a PNG fixture for a real screen capture, or close it. Closed automatically after the case.

path.description: PNG fixture; relative paths resolve from the repository root.

seed_clipboard_image_arg.description: Browser-only: put a PNG fixture ({path}) or a screenshot of one element ({selector}) on Chromium's clipboard as image/png.
